messages:
maria-ml: Hey runtime — onboarding QA for aurora-34b-multwindow. We pushed weights to s3://rw-models/aurora/34b/v2/weights.tar and tokenizer to s3://rw-models/aurora/34b/v2/tokenizer.json. Can someone sanity-check RoPE scaling + sliding-window + MQA/GQA masks? I'm seeing tokenizer producing trailing \u0120 tokens in a few samples. /cc @sam-runtime @jen-eng

sam-runtime: Looking. Quick question: model is MQA-pretrained or GQA? config.json says "multi_query": true. If MQA we need the kv cache packing check. share config snippet?

maria-ml: config snippet:
```
{"model_type":"decoder","multi_query":true,"rope_scaling":{"type":"linear","factor":1.5},"max_seq_len":65536}
```

jen-eng: thanks. Two quick checks I ran: sliding-window tokenization looks fine for small inputs. But RoPE scaling in our runtime defaults to rotary_dim=64; with factor 1.5 we hit inaccurate phase wrap on long sequences. I ran a small inference with seq_len=32k; saw mismatch vs reference (hf) at token 12000. log:
```
[WARN] rope_phase_wrap at step 12012: delta=0.0032
```

liam-sre: For MQA we have a patch in review that fixes KV layout when head_k=1. See PR #4123. If you can toggle multi_query=false as a quick A/B to see behavior, that helps.

maria-ml: toggled to false and re-ran fuzz tests — passes upto 48k tokens. With true, we get weird repetition at ~10k.

sam-runtime: Can you paste a minimal failing input? Also what's tokenizer issue?

maria-ml: small repro: "A long string..." (not pasting) but tokenizer occasionally emits `</s>` inside a paragraph due to bytepair rules — likely due to space handling. Tokenizer file shows `special_tokens_map` missing `pad_token`. snippet:
```
{"bos_token":"","eos_token":"","unk_token":"<|unk|>"}
```

jen-eng: aha missing pad. We should add pad token to tokenizer and ensure `pad_token_id` present in model config. Without pad, sliding-window with padding can trigger mid-sequence end-of-sentence tokens.

runtime-ci: CI tokenization-run: 2 failures when `multi_query=true` + `rope_scaling.factor>1.2`. Full log uploaded: https://internal.ci/runs/5589

maria-ml: action items: (1) add pad_token + pad_token_id to tokenizer/model config (maria) (2) try multi_query=false as short-term (maria) (3) runtime folks to run PR #4123 and validate KV layout under MQA (sam) (4) add regression test for rope_scaling factors >1.2 (jen) (5) update weight path in onboarding doc (maria)

sam-runtime: I'll pull PR #4123 to a branch and run the 32k fuzz job. ETA today EOD.

liam-sre: if we see production traffic for this model, we'll pin fallback to aurora-34b-v1 in routing for 24h.

maria-ml: thanks all. ping me if you need the precise failing payload. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment created for branch `mqa-kv-fix` by sam-runtime — build 9921

sam-runtime: build 9921 green on smoke with multi_query=false. Will run full fuzz with true after patch merges.

jen-eng: added regression test stub in tests/rope_scaling_test.py, PR incoming.

maria-ml: closing loop later today, will update onboarding checklist.
